subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new global/per-model non-resetting generation-timeout config surface, and if so what key name and precedence should it have against provider request, first-event, idle, and run timeouts?
rationale: The missing behavior is a new public config/default surface in a compatibility-sensitive provider-routing path, so source inspection can prove the gap but cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Add generationTimeout
options.body: Add a canonical global and per-model generationTimeout contract that enforces a non-resetting active-generation budget and maps timeout aborts into fallback handling.

options.title: Reuse provider timeout only
options.body: Document models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds as the supported timeout surface and close the per-agent-model config request as not planned.

options.title: Split adjacent semantics
options.body: Keep this issue for the config contract and route first-token, provider-skip, and repetition-loop semantics to their existing separate issues.

recommendation.title: Add generationTimeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical global and per-model generationTimeout contract that enforces a non-resetting active-generation budget and maps timeout aborts into fallback handling.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the detailed issue review and has recent commits in the embedded runner timeout path where the decision would land.
